parceria.intro_text: We believe in the power of strategic partnerships to leverage the agricultural sector. By becoming a partner of Base Agro Data, your organization gains direct access to a qualified network of producers, entrepreneurs, and decision-makers.
parceria.stats_text: Mozambique's largest interactive database, connecting producers and markets with real-time data.
parceria.who_text: All entities operating in the agricultural sector can be our partners, but our collaboration is focused on organizations operating in strategic areas that directly boost production, productivity and sustainability in the field.
parceria.who_item1_desc: Seed, fertilizer, and machinery companies looking to expand their reach.
parceria.who_item2_desc: Banks and microfinance interested in financing the growth of the agricultural sector.
parceria.who_item3_desc: NGOs and projects focused on social impact and sustainable rural development.
parceria.who_item4_desc: Startups and software companies offering management solutions for the field.
parceria.form_text: Fill out the form and our partnerships team will get in touch.
parceria.premium_text: Leading organizations that trust our Agricultural Database to drive agrarian development in Mozambique are our main partners.
